name: floating-dock

frames.best_why: Bell icon is swelled with its label shown and the next icon partly enlarged.

tagline: Bottom icon bar where the circle nearest the cursor swells and names itself.
summary: A rounded dark dock of five circular icon links that magnify like a desktop dock. The nearest icon grows on a spring, its neighbours swell a little, and a small label appears above.
appearance: A rounded dark bar near the bottom of the stage holding five grey circular icon buttons: home, magnifier, bell, person and gear. Hovering one swells it and shows a small label above.
behaviour: As the pointer nears, the closest circle grows on a spring and its neighbours swell slightly; hovering also reveals a small tooltip with the item name. Everything shrinks back when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Five icons labelled Home, Search, Notifications, Profile and Settings.
search_phrases: bottom bar with icons that grow
icon bar that enlarges near the cursor
desktop style dock for a website
tooltip above each icon on hover
use_when: A compact set of top-level destinations should stay reachable at the edge of the screen.
avoid_when: It relies on hover magnification, so touch users only get the plain icon row and no labels.
customise: Pass an items array of title, icon and href plus desktop and mobile class names. Sizes, spring settings and tooltip styling are fixed.
weight_why: Five spring-driven icon buttons and tooltips; no loops.

a11y.note: Icon links have no accessible name, tooltips only show on hover, and the springs ignore reduced-motion.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string; icon: ReactNode; href: string }[]

issues: Icon-only links rely on a hover tooltip for their name, so keyboard and screen readers get no label.
Frames 2 to 5 show only the desktop dock; the mobile expanding menu is never captured.
polish_why: Crisp magnification and tidy tooltips; the small circles on black read softly.
title: Floating Dock
